_chart: Round 1 samples for Life Chapters: the golden rewrite (Q2), chart B (1990-09-17 05:00 Beijing) and chart C (1992-05-25, hour unknown). Pages group by chart.

units.where: The Early Chapter · the Steward at the Year Gate · lived (rewrite)
units.text: Your Early Chapter was an orderly one, with set hours, set chores and someone who always did what they said. You came out of it careful, and you still feel safest when your days run to a plan.

units.where: The Early Chapter · the Magistrate at the Year Gate · lived
units.text: Your Early Chapter ran on rules, with clear expectations at home and someone older who meant every one of them. You learned early to behave well in front of others, and you still notice who is in charge before you notice anything else.

units.where: The Early Chapter · Virtuoso decade 1997 to 2006 · weighed
units.text: These years sharpened your tongue faster than your judgement, and you learned what it costs to say the clever thing out loud.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · the Twin at the Month Gate · lived
units.text: Your Rising Chapter was the one where you proved yourself alone. Through your twenties you took whole jobs and signed your name to them, and you left that chapter trusting what you carried yourself over anything you were handed.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · the General inside the Month Gate · lived
units.text: Beneath it ran pressure from above, a hard manager or a test you could not refuse. You worked hardest when someone pushed you, and you came out of those years tougher than you went in.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · Artisan decade 2007 to 2016 · weighed
units.text: These years made life easy enough to drift in, with good company and pleasures that filled the days. You enjoyed more than you built, and you left them knowing what comfort costs you.

units.where: Now · Steward decade 2017 to 2026 · weighs
units.text: This decade asks you to keep things, the accounts and the promises and the household that depends on them. You work harder for each gain than the people around you, and much of what you earn goes straight back into upkeep. You end it with a clear count of what your life costs to run.

units.where: The Home Chapter · the General inside the Day Gate · now
units.text: Your Home Chapter is the hardest-working stretch of your life, with a partner as strong-willed as you and a household that asks a great deal of you both. Since your mid-thirties pressure has come home with you instead of staying at work. You grow tougher in this chapter than in any before it.

units.where: The Home Chapter · Horizon decade 2027 to 2036 · weighs
units.text: This decade scatters your effort across side ventures and offers that each want a piece of you. You chase more than you can hold, and you keep only what you chose with care.

units.where: The Home Chapter · Magistrate decade 2037 to 2046 · weighs
units.text: This decade loads you with duty, a title or a role that others measure you by. You carry more rules than you would choose, and you earn a standing nobody can take from you.

units.where: The Late Chapter · the Horizon at the Hour Gate · coming, from 2038
units.text: Your Late Chapter is the open-handed one, with money and company arriving from more directions than before. From your late forties you take on side ventures for the pleasure of them, and you give more freely than you ever let yourself earlier.

units.where: The Late Chapter · the Twin inside the Hour Gate · coming
units.text: Behind it stands a circle of equals, the people after you treated as partners rather than followers. You keep your own counsel in these years, and you share the work only with those who carry their part.

units.where: The Late Chapter · General decade 2047 to 2056 · weighs
units.text: This decade brings pressure that does not let up, from a demanding role or people who test you. You hold your ground through it, and you come out harder to shake than anyone around you.

units.where: The Late Chapter · Sage decade 2057 to 2066 · helping
units.text: This decade brings you shelter and good teachers, people glad to share what they know. You learn more in these years than in your busiest ones, and you accept help more easily than before.

units.where: 2026 · a Virtuoso year · now
units.text: Your tongue gets sharper than your judgement this year, and a remark you meant as honest lands as a challenge. You pay for one argument with someone above you, and you come out of it surer of what you think.

units.where: 2026 · repeats the 午 of your Year Gate
units.text: You go back over something from your first home this year, an old habit or an old grievance you thought was settled.

units.where: 2027 · an Artisan year (window option)
units.text: Comfort pulls at you this year, good food and easy company and work that asks too little. You finish less than you planned, and you rest more deeply than you have in years.

units.where: 2027 · joins your Hour Gate (卯未)
units.text: You bring the people after you into a shared plan this year, and you lead it more easily than you expected.

units.where: 2028 · a Steward year (window option)
units.text: Money and duty both tighten this year, with bills to meet and promises to keep on time. Each gain costs you more effort than it should, and you end the year with your accounts in better order than they began.

units.where: 2029 · a Horizon year (window option)
units.text: Offers and side roads multiply this year, and each one wants your time or your money. You say yes to more than you can carry, and you learn quickly which ones to drop.

units.where: 2029 · clashes with your Hour Gate (卯酉)
units.text: You face a sharp change with the people after you this year, a move or a break in plans you made together.

units.where: 2030 · a Magistrate year (window option)
units.text: Rules close in this year, a new manager or a formal duty or an obligation you cannot refuse. You do what is asked of you without complaint, and people trust you more for it by the end.

units.where: 2030 · harms your Month Gate (酉戌)
units.text: Something at work sours quietly this year, a colleague or an arrangement that stops serving you, and you see it before anyone says it.

units.where: 2031 · a General year (window option)
units.text: Pressure comes at you from several sides this year, a rival or a hard demand or a deadline that will not move. You stand firm through it, and you finish tired and harder to push around.

units.where: The Early Chapter · the Virtuoso at the Year Gate · lived
units.text: Your Early Chapter was a loud one, full of talk and talent and a habit of answering back. You were the clever child who questioned every rule at home, and you still speak up faster than you plan to.

units.where: The Early Chapter · the Rival inside the Year Gate · lived
units.text: Inside it ran a contest for attention, with someone in your first home who wanted whatever you had. You learned to hold on to your share early, and you still notice who is taking more than theirs.

units.where: The Early Chapter · Steward decade 1998 to 2007 · weighed
units.text: These years kept you careful, with money and treats counted out and little left over for whim. You learned to want less than you were offered, and you still find spending harder than saving.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · the Horizon at the Month Gate · now
units.text: Your Rising Chapter is the wide one, full of side ventures, new places and people who bring you offers. Since your late teens your work has rarely kept to one track, and you earn best when you have several things running at once.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · the Magistrate inside the Month Gate · now
units.text: Beneath it runs a quiet respect for rules, a sense of what is proper that you rarely show. You keep your promises at work more strictly than anyone asks, and you judge others by whether they keep theirs.

units.where: The Rising Chapter · Artisan decade 2008 to 2017 · weighed (shared with chart B)
units.text: These years made life easy enough to drift in, with good company and pleasures that filled the days. You enjoyed more than you built, and you left them knowing what comfort costs you.

units.where: Now · Virtuoso decade 2018 to 2027 · weighs
units.text: This decade gives you a sharp voice and little patience for rules you did not write. You say what others only think, at work and at home, and it costs you goodwill with the people above you. You end it knowing exactly where your talent lies, and you no longer hide it to keep the peace.

units.where: The Home Chapter · the Alchemist inside the Day Gate · coming, from 2027
units.text: Your Home Chapter turns inward, with a partner who thinks in unusual ways and a home given over to study and private plans. From your mid-thirties you spend more time on your own interests than on company. You understand yourself better here than in any chapter before it, and you need fewer people to feel at home.

units.where: The Home Chapter · Twin decade 2028 to 2037 · helping
units.text: This decade puts you on your own feet, with equals beside you instead of people over you. You take on work in your own name, and you grow steadier with every job you finish alone.

units.where: The Home Chapter · Rival decade 2038 to 2047 · helping
units.text: This decade brings company that competes, friends and partners who want what you want. You win more of those contests than you lose, and you finish with a larger share than you began with.

units.where: The Late Chapter (closed) · Alchemist decade 2048 to 2057 · helping
units.text: This decade turns you toward unusual knowledge, a craft or a study few people share. You go deep on your own terms, and you become the person others consult when the usual answers fail.

units.where: 2026 · a Magistrate year · now (shared with chart B)
units.text: Rules close in this year, a new manager or a formal duty or an obligation you cannot refuse. You do what is asked of you without complaint, and people trust you more for it by the end.

units.where: 2026 · harms your Day Gate (丑午)
units.text: A small resentment grows at home this year, and you clear it only once you name it to your partner.

units.where: 2027 · a General year (shared with chart B)
units.text: Pressure comes at you from several sides this year, a rival or a hard demand or a deadline that will not move. You stand firm through it, and you finish tired and harder to push around.

units.where: 2028 · a Sage year (window option)
units.text: Help arrives this year without your asking, from a mentor or someone older who simply believes in you. You accept it gracefully, and you understand your own direction better by the end.

units.where: 2028 · punishes your Month Gate (巳申)
units.text: You come under scrutiny at work this year, a review or a rule applied to you more strictly than to others.

units.where: 2029 · an Alchemist year (window option)
units.text: Your curiosity sharpens this year, toward a strange subject or a skill few people around you have. You study it alone and in your own way, and by the end you know something that sets you apart.

units.where: 2030 · a Rival year (window option)
units.text: Competition sharpens you this year, a colleague or a friend chasing the same prize. You push harder than usual, and you come away with more than you expected.

units.where: 2030 · punishes your Day Gate (丑戌)
units.text: Home asks more of your patience this year, and you hold the peace with a partner by giving way on small things.

units.where: 2031 · a Twin year (window option)
units.text: Equals gather around you this year, a partner in a venture or a friend who matches your pace. You do your best work side by side with them, and you finish the year surer of your own strength.
